info.title: GGScore v2 (Public API)
info.description: Public paid API: played & upcoming matches, single match, per-map `games` and `games[].players` box scores, player cards (`GET /player/{id}`), team & event cards, maps catalog, recent matches per map, paginated teams & events, countries. Authenticate with X-API-Key. Full API docs at /api/v2/redoc.

get.description: Unauthenticated heartbeat returning `{ "message": "pong" }`. Does not consume the daily plan quota. Still throttled per client IP (or RapidAPI user) to prevent abuse; excess calls return HTTP 429 with Retry-After. Use for load balancers, synthetic monitoring, and RapidAPI base-path verification.

Returns every country row used for filters and team geography. Requires `X-API-Key` (direct) or a RapidAPI subscription that forwards the key. Rate limited per plan. Successful and HTTP 429 responses include `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (next midnight UTC). Unknown query keys are ignored or forwarded depending on repository support.

200.description: JSON array of country objects (`id`, `title`, `code`, …). Additional filter query parameters may be forwarded to the repository when supported.

401.description: Missing or invalid `X-API-Key` (or invalid RapidAPI-provisioned secret when enforcement is on).

429.description: Daily or per-window rate limit exceeded for the caller's plan.

502.description: Upstream data source error while resolving countries.

503.description: Temporary outage or maintenance on the backing data service.

get.description: Paginated finished CS2 matches (both teams scored, `played_at` set). Each `MatchItem` may include `games` (per-map results, BO series order) and `clips` (Twitch highlights). Supports the same filter query parameters as the internal listing (e.g. team, event, date) when passed as query string.
